name: Agile Runner (Monster)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Quadruped or winged creature, Run, Dex 13 (15 if winged)

Benefit(s): When running, you may make a 90 degree turn a number of times equal to your Dexterity bonus.

Special: Flying creatures with a Dexterity of 15 or greater may take this feat and use it while flying.
